abstract_sentences.text: Diffusion models have demonstrated strong generative performance; however, generated samples often fail to fully align with human intent.

abstract_sentences.text: This paper studies an efficient test-time scaling method for sampling from regions with higher human-aligned reward values.
abstract_sentences.transition: narrows the response target after the gap

evidence.anchor: This paper studies an efficient test-time scaling method.

abstract_sentences.text: Existing methods for computing the expected future reward (EFR) face important limitations: backward rollout incurs prohibitively high sampling costs, while Tweedie-based approaches, including Sequential Monte Carlo and gradient guidance, suffer from bias and inherent sampling issues.
abstract_sentences.comparison: backward rollout against Tweedie-based SMC and gradient guidance

evidence.anchor: backward rollout incurs prohibitively high sampling costs

abstract_sentences.text: We show that the EFR at any xt can be computed using only marginal samples from a pre-trained diffusion model, enabling closed-form reward guidance without neural backpropagation.

evidence.anchor: EFR at any xt can be computed using only marginal samples

abstract_sentences.text: To further improve efficiency, we introduce a few-step lookahead sampling and an accurate solver that guides particles toward high-reward lookahead samples.
abstract_sentences.transition: turns the reformulation into a sampler

evidence.anchor: we introduce a few-step lookahead sampling

abstract_sentences.text: We refer to this sampling scheme as LiDAR sampling.

evidence.anchor: We refer to this sampling scheme as LiDAR sampling.

abstract_sentences.text: LiDAR achieves the same GenEval performance as the latest gradient guidance method for SDXL with a 9.5× speedup.
abstract_sentences.comparison: LiDAR versus latest gradient guidance on SDXL
abstract_sentences.transition: puts the strongest benchmark claim after the method name

evidence.anchor: same GenEval performance ... SDXL with a 9.5× speedup

abstract_analysis.reported_result: Same GenEval performance on SDXL as latest gradient guidance with 9.5× speedup.

introduction_moves.question_left: How can EFR be computed during iterative sampling?

introduction_moves.question_left: What replaces the existing EFR approximations?
